entities.summary: The Safa Mosque is a Shi'ite mosque, located near the Shahshahan mausoleum, in Esfahan, in the province of Isfahan, Iran. The mosque was built by Mohammad Golestaneh in 1290 AH (1873/1874 CE), during the Qajar era.
